name: Airtable
description: Monitor Airtable bases and workspace configuration for data access compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Go to https://airtable.com/create/tokens and sign in.
2. Click "Create new token".
3. Grant the following scopes:
   - schema.bases:read (list bases and their permission levels)
   - user.email:read (identify the token owner)
4. Under "Access", choose "All current and future bases in all current and future workspaces".
5. Create the token and copy the value (starts with "pat").
6. Paste it into the Personal Access Token field above.

Note: Listing all workspaces requires an Airtable Enterprise plan and additional enterprise scopes. These checks operate at the bases level so they work for every plan tier.

checks.name: Employee Access
checks.description: Verifies the Personal Access Token owner and the bases reachable for employee access auditing.

checks.description: Reviews Airtable bases and their permission levels to support access reviews.
